# BulletedList

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.text.tex\_mobject.BulletedList`

class BulletedList(*\*items*, *buff=0.5*, *dot\_scale\_factor=2*, *tex\_environment=None*, *dot\_buff=0.1*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Tex`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.Tex.html#manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.Tex "manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.Tex")

    A bulleted list.

    Parameters:
    :   - **items** (*str*) – The text elements.
        - **buff** (*float*) – The vertical spacing between the list elements.
        - **dot\_scale\_factor** (*float*) – The scale factor for the bullets.
        - **tex\_environment** (*str* *|* *None*) – The tex environment used for the text elements.
        - **dot\_buff** (*float*) – The horizontal spacing between the dots and the text elements.
        - **kwargs** (*Any*)

    Examples

    Example: BulletedListExample

    ![../_images/BulletedListExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/BulletedListExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class BulletedListExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            blist = BulletedList("Item 1", "Item 2", "Item 3", height=2, width=2)
            blist.set_color_by_tex("Item 1", RED)
            blist.set_color_by_tex("Item 2", GREEN)
            blist.set_color_by_tex("Item 3", BLUE)
            self.add(blist)
    ```
